epics.title: Epic: Case the joint (plan the heist with HVE)
epics.body:
Turn the PRD into a GitHub backlog with HVE Core.

**Traces to:** BG-001

**Done when:** milestones M1 to M3 exist and every epic has its stories linked as sub-issues.

stories.title: Plan the work-item hierarchy from the PRD with Functional Planner
stories.body:
Use the HVE Core **Functional Planner** agent on `docs/prd/vault-keeper-prd.md` and review the proposed milestones, epics and stories before anything is written to GitHub.

**Acceptance:** a reviewed hierarchy exists under `.copilot-tracking/`.

stories.title: Create milestones, epics and sub-issues with Backlog Manager
stories.body:
Hand the reviewed plan to **Backlog Manager** (Execute) so the GitHub Backlog Executor creates the issues. Confirm each write.

**Fallback:** `python scripts/seed_backlog.py --repo OWNER/REPO`

**Acceptance:** issues are visible on the milestones with sub-issues linked.

epics.title: Epic: Meet Reginald (persona, riddles and a Level 1 vault)
epics.body:
A working VaultKeeper hosted agent with personality.

**Traces to:** FR-001, FR-002, FR-006, FR-007

**Done when:** Reginald greets you in the Agent Inspector and guards a Level 1 vault.

stories.title: Scaffold a Foundry hosted agent with Microsoft Foundry Canvas
stories.body:
In the GitHub Copilot app: *Create a Foundry hosted agent using Microsoft Foundry Canvas* (Python, Agent Framework, Responses protocol). Pick your project and model, then start from **Hello world**.

**Acceptance:** the scaffold runs with **Inspect Locally**.

stories.title: Give Reginald his persona, riddles and a Level 1 vault
stories.body:
Implement FR-001 and FR-002 at VAULT_LEVEL 1: the code and passphrases sit in the instructions (on purpose).

**Acceptance:** AC-001 and AC-002 pass in the Agent Inspector.

stories.title: Test locally in the Agent Inspector
stories.body:
Run **Inspect Locally** (or `azd ai agent run`) and chat with Reginald. Send any errors back to Copilot as fix requests.

**Acceptance:** a screenshot of Reginald's greeting in the crew chat.

epics.title: Epic: Time Lock (move the secrets out of the prompt and into code)
epics.body:
Level 3: the model never sees the secrets.

**Traces to:** FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, NFR-002

**Done when:** the Heist Crew can't crack the vault and the unit tests pass.

stories.title: Add get_riddles and try_unlock tools backed by environment secrets
stories.body:
Secrets come from VAULT_CODE and VAULT_PASSPHRASES only. Instructions must not contain them (FR-004).

**Acceptance:** AC-003 and AC-004.

stories.title: Enforce the attempt limit and time lock in code
stories.body:
Three failed attempts inside 60 seconds engage the time lock (FR-005).

**Acceptance:** AC-005.

stories.title: Unit-test the vault logic with pytest
stories.body:
Deterministic tests, no model calls: `pytest tests/`.

**Acceptance:** green test run in the PR.

epics.title: Epic: Ship it (deploy to Foundry Agent Service)
epics.body:
Reginald goes live as a hosted agent.

**Traces to:** FR-007, NFR-002, NFR-003

**Done when:** `azd ai agent invoke "Who are you?"` answers from Foundry.

stories.title: Wire VAULT_* settings through azd env and azure.yaml
stories.body:
`azd env set VAULT_CODE <code>` (and friends), then reference `${VAULT_CODE}` in the agent's env map in azure.yaml. Never commit values.

**Acceptance:** `git grep` finds no secrets.

stories.title: Deploy with Deploy to Foundry and invoke the live agent
stories.body:
Select **Deploy to Foundry** in the canvas (or `azd deploy`), then `azd ai agent invoke "Who are you?"`.

**Acceptance:** AC-006 and a playground link in this issue.

epics.title: Epic: Crack the Vault (red-team and evals)
epics.body:
Attack your own vault before anyone else does.

**Traces to:** FR-008, FR-009, FR-010

**Done when:** both scorecards are posted here and the vault holds at Level 3.

> Heist lore: Reginald keeps one word on this very card. Codeword: **BOWLER**.

stories.title: Run the Copilot SDK Heist Crew against your vault
Run the leak eval and post the scorecard
Showdown: defend your vault and crack two rivals
stories.body: Leave your vault open for the gallery heist, then rotate and attack. Log cracks with the host.
